segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Good morning everyone, welcome to the phase two diligence session for Project Falcon.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Thanks David. Acme Capital is pleased with initial diligence, but today we need clarity on financials and customer concentration.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: Happy to walk through the numbers. For fiscal year 2023, Northwind Analytics generated eighteen million in total revenue.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: And on the profitability side, Sarah? We have been analyzing the adjusted operating metrics.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: Our EBITDA was 4.2 million for the last fiscal year, representing an operating margin of approximately twenty-three percent.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: That is solid expansion from FY22. Our gross margin also stabilized at seventy-eight percent.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Understood. Now regarding corporate expenses, we noticed a software infrastructure commitment pending approval.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: Yes, I approve the fifteen thousand dollars vendor expenditure for CloudScale Systems data migration.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: That migration is scheduled for completion within the next thirty days.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Let us discuss the transaction perimeter. Acme is structuring this as an asset purchase agreement with a ten percent holdback.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Northwind board reviewed the term sheet. The indicative valuation of forty-five million enterprise value is acceptable.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: We will require a forty-five day exclusivity window starting immediately upon signature.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: The board agreed to the exclusivity term during yesterday's special meeting.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Now regarding customer accounts, we notice significant revenue tied to two large enterprise clients.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Yes, customer concentration is our primary diligence risk: our top two enterprise accounts account for forty-five percent of ARR.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Are both contracts up for renewal within the next twelve months?

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: The primary account is on a multi-year term through 2026. The second renews in November.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Priya, could your team prepare the detailed customer cohort analysis and churn data?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Priya sends customer concentration data by Friday. I will have the breakdown ready by end of day Friday.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Perfect. What about key personnel retention post-closing?

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: All senior engineers and department heads will enter into non-compete and retention agreements.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: Special advisor Zephyrine Quillfeather confirmed the audit schedule and compliance checklist.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Zephyrine reviewed the environmental and security diligence questionnaires as well.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Any outstanding litigation or regulatory inquiries we should be aware of?

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Zero pending litigation. We completed our SOC 2 Type II audit last quarter without exceptions.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: Total cash on balance sheet currently stands at three million two hundred thousand dollars.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: And long-term debt obligations?

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: We have a credit line of one million with Zenith Bank, currently drawn at four hundred thousand.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Acme will not assume that credit line; it will be paid off at closing from transaction proceeds.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Agreed. Let us ensure the definitive purchase agreement reflects that payoff.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: On product roadmap, our machine learning pipeline is launching in late Q3.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Does that require additional capital expenditures in the current year?

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: No, budgeted CapEx of two hundred fifty thousand covers all hardware and hosting costs.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: We have maintained a disciplined cash burn rate of under fifty thousand per month.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Excellent. Who is handling intellectual property assignment confirmations?

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Marcus, our outside counsel will provide IP assignment certificates for all eighty-five employees.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: Please have those uploaded to the data room by Monday afternoon.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: I will coordinate with legal counsel to ensure all IP schedules are posted by Monday.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: To recap next steps: Priya sends cohort data by Friday, legal uploads IP certificates by Monday.

segments.speaker: Marcus Brody
segments.text: And Acme team will circulate the revised asset purchase agreement by next Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Sarah Chen
segments.text: Thank you everyone for the constructive session today.

segments.speaker: David Vance
segments.text: Thank you all, meeting adjourned.
